This section can be blank if this pull request does not require a release note.

- [KEP]: <link>

review_comments: We are still disabling VAP plugin here. Could you confirm that is what we want? Thank you.
good catch, I'd expect this to "just work" now with the admission init move
Yes, refer the above comments. This test setting is specific to extended apiserver with admission and filter disabled. I guess it makes sense to keep VAP plugin the same setting as others here.

ah, ok... if we're not giving it a connection to kube-apiserver then it won't work :)

I'm fine with this either way... if it works with VAP, great. If it doesn't (like all the other admission plugins that require talking to kube-apiserver in this specific test), I'm ok with it being disabled in this specific test.
